title: The Peninsula Family Day Out
dek: A gondola ride, a brewery lunch and a bay beach, with a coffee stop only if the day runs early.

bookingChecklist.item: Check Arthurs Seat Eagle operating conditions and ticket options
Confirm Red Hill Brewery is serving lunch on your chosen day
Check Commonfolk Mornington's closing time if you want the optional coffee stop

stops.note: Start with a return gondola ride, about 15 minutes each way, and pause at the summit lookout. You can board at the base or summit station; check conditions and choose your starting car park before you travel.
The deck and beer garden make this a relaxed family lunch. The bar and kitchen are usually open Thursday to Sunday, with food from midday; menus vary, so check today's service before setting out.
Make the beach the afternoon pause. Choose whether to swim after checking the day's conditions, and supervise children near the water.
Only add this Mornington coffee stop if you can reach it before closing. Commonfolk's weekend cafe service ends at 3 pm, and weekday service at 3:30 pm. Otherwise, let the beach be the finish.

editorNote: Keep the Eagle, brewery lunch and beach as the three anchors. This route works best Thursday to Sunday when the brewery bar and kitchen usually serve lunch; confirm current hours and menu, including public holiday changes. The Eagle can close in extreme weather, and its flexi tickets do not require a reserved time. The final coffee is optional, because Commonfolk Mornington closes at 3 pm on weekends.
